title: Ijwi ry'ubwenge mu bitutu
intro: Umuntu wo mu bihe vya kera, azwi ko afise ubukerebutsi bwimbitse, arakubwira mu binjana vyose. Uwo muntu ntiyigeze yivugira ko ari umuhanuzi, yamara ubukerebutsi buva ku Mana bwaciye mu majambo yabo. Umuvyeyi yasize iragi ry’ubuyobozi ridahera, impanuro zabo ziguma zizigamye mu mitima y’abantu amamiliyoni, zigasomwa kandi zikazirikana gushika n’uyu musi.
clues: Naronse ingabire y’Imana yantandukanije n’abandi - ubwenge bwimbitse cane bwacitse akaranga kanje gasobanura muri kahise kose.
Sinari intumwa canke umumarayika - umutima gusa wahezagiwe n’ugutahura kwimbitse n’ugutahura isi.
Ubucuti bwanje bwa hafi cane bwari ubw’umwana wanje, kandi biciye kuri ubwo bucuti, ubutumwa bwanje buramba cane bwarashikirijwe.
Narahimiriza gukengurukira Uwampaye vyose, kandi ndagabisha ku bijanye n’ubwibone n’ubwibone.
Narigishije ivyerekeye uburemere bw’ibikorwa mbere n’ivy’akabuto ka sinapi, n’akamaro ko guca bugufi ijwi mu kwicisha bugufi.
Igice kimwe muri Korowani citiriwe izina ryanje, aho impanuro yanje ku muhungu wanje nkunda zizigamiwe ibihe bidahera.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
